# Router configuration fixtures

These are synthetic, redacted UCI fixtures modeling configuration shapes seen
across GL.iNet and generic OpenWrt families. They contain no real credentials or
factory identifiers. Hardware names exist only to prove that portable mapping
does not depend on them.

- `flint2/`: tri-radio style GL.iNet 4.x configuration with DSA-like names.
- `beryl-ax/`: dual-band travel-router shape and guest network.
- `triband-6e/`: target with 2.4/5/6 GHz capabilities.
- `generic-openwrt/`: vanilla OpenWrt logical LAN and firewall zones.
